description: This file sets up a Streamlit-based web interface for a SQL database chatbot using LangChain and OpenAI models. It includes environment configuration, database connection, language model and agent setup, a prompt template for user queries, and a main function to handle user interactions and display responses.

classes.name: count_tokens
classes.description: A function that runs a query through a language model chain, with token usage tracking and error handling.

classes.name: main
classes.description: The main function that runs the Streamlit app, handling user input and displaying chatbot responses.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: Executes a query through the language model chain, tracking token usage and handling exceptions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes and runs the Streamlit web interface for user interaction with the SQL database chatbot.
